title: New in the lab: digital image correlation and 3D scanning
summary: The group has added a digital image correlation (DIC) setup for full-field strain measurement and a 3D scanner for dimensional checks of printed parts.

title: Principal Investigator from Saudi Arabia (KFUPM), British Council 2026 Gender Equality Partnerships Grant, “Creating Inclusive Leadership Pathways for Women Academics: A UK–Saudi Initiative”, with Edinburgh Napier University, UK.
location: KFUPM, Dhahran, Saudi Arabia, with Edinburgh Napier University, UK
summary: Dr. Seid Ahmed is the Principal Investigator from Saudi Arabia on “Creating Inclusive Leadership Pathways for Women Academics: A UK–Saudi Initiative”. With Edinburgh Napier University (UK lead: Prof. Islam Shyha), the project was successful in the British Council 2026 Gender Equality Partnerships Grant call.

title: Dr. Seid Ahmed receives The Best Emerging Coach Award at KFUPM
summary: Dr. Seid Ahmed received The Best Emerging Coach Award from King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals. The award was granted on May 2026 as a prize recognising her contribution as an emerging coach.It reflects her commitment to guiding and supporting others at KFUPM.

title: industry collaboration
summary: KFUPM and Aramco have signed a mutual NDA, led by Dr. Yassmin Seid Ahmed (Sustainable Polymer Manufacturing Group). This is an important step toward a proposed technical collaboration in polymer manufacturing, with technical discussions.
